name: @minidregg/sdk
description: Mini client SDK (TypeScript): profiles, typed intents, explain, consent-gated signing, attempt custody. Mirrors native/mini-sdk byte for byte.

scripts.build:core: cargo build --offline --locked --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm --manifest-path ../mini-sdk/Cargo.toml && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir wasm "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-../mini-sdk/target}/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/mini_sdk.wasm" && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('wasm/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')"
